core_obligations: Replace K by a complex (proof lines 7866-7867): represent K by a bounded below complex G^bullet of abelian sheaves on S_etale, with G^n = 0 for n < a.
Pass to the pullbacks (proof lines 7868-7870): let F_i^bullet and F^bullet be the pullbacks of G^bullet to X_i and X; these represent K|_{X_i} and K|_X.
Identify the limit complex as a colimit (proof lines 7870-7872): termwise one has F^bullet = colim f_i^{-1} F_i^bullet.

Apply the cited variant lemma (proof lines 7872-7873): with these identifications the statement becomes the earlier result on colimits of complexes, which gives the required identification of the colimit of the H^p_etale(X_i, K|_{X_i}) with H^p_etale(X, K|_X).
proof_roadmap: Represent K by a bounded below complex of abelian sheaves on S_etale.
Pull it back to the X_i and to X; these complexes represent the objects appearing in the statement.
Note that the pullback to X is the termwise colimit of the pulled back complexes along the transition maps.
Apply the same-chapter variant lemma on colimits of complexes to conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the etale cohomology of a directed limit of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes over S with the colimit of the cohomologies of the approximants, for coefficients in a bounded below object of D^+(S_etale) (statement lines 7852-7863). The reduction is explicit but requires choosing the right representative: one replaces K by a bounded below complex G^bullet with G^n = 0 for n < a, pulls it back to X_i and to X, and observes that the pullback to the limit is the termwise colimit of the F_i^bullet along the transition maps (proof lines 7866-7872). The statement then becomes the same-chapter variant lemma on colimits of complexes, which the author invokes (proof line 7873). The claim is H2: one reduction to a concrete complex plus one colimit identification, with the bounded-below hypothesis used to make the representative exist.
